This plot is small, only 0.16 hectares, so I will manage it mostly with my family's own labor and whatever inputs we can afford or get through the subsidy program. I will apply both chemical fertilizer and manure because the soil needs nutrients to grow good rice, and I will use improved seed since it gives better harvests than the local varieties. We cannot afford pesticides or hired workers for such a small piece, so we will do all the weeding and bird scaring ourselves. The plot stays wet enough during the rains because it is in a low area, so we do not need to irrigate it.
